submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One standalone full-body transparent RGBA game run animation sprite. Native square at least 1024 pixels. Image1 exact identity. Image2 direction reference. Image3 approved crisp hand-painted Q style. Image4 previous phase for consistent proportions, camera and clothing, not for copying the pose. Preserve purple hair lotus crown, lilac-white-gold embroidered costume, short chibi limbs and boots, same long purple-gold qin. Facing southeast toward lower-right, front-right three-quarter view. Her anatomical RIGHT side is the near side on screen-left, LEFT side the far side on screen-right. Left hand on elevated qin neck screen-right; right hand at lower strings screen-left.
CRITICAL POSE: Descending before RIGHT foot contact to close the run loop. Near anatomical RIGHT leg unfolds down and forward, knee nearly straight but soft; large near right boot lowers to x615y928, toe slightly raised heel down, about to land. Far anatomical LEFT calf folds high behind hip, small left boot at x410y835. Torso descends 12px from apex but same head/body size. This must bridge airborne15 to right-contact01: right leading shoe almost flat in anticipation of weight, not continued knee-up. Qin comes slightly closer to chest and elbows soften opposite the forward right hip.
Keep anatomical LEFT hand on upper qin neck and RIGHT hand on lower strings. All body parts attached with credible shoulder-elbow-wrist and hip-knee-ankle chains. No mirrors. Fixed camera and global scale, crown around125 and virtual root512,942 on virtual1024 canvas; natural body bob without changing body proportions. Maintain image4 head size. Transparent backdrop, no floor, no shadow, no text, no VFX, no contact sheet, exactly one character. Highest visual finish.
